s: February 14, 2020 - However, they do not “sleep”, because they have urgent tasks to accomplish: the care to be given to the brood does not stop overnight, the frames to be built urgently during intense honey flow will also be done during the night. More generally all the young bees, the internal bees of the hive (nurses, cleaners, waxers and builders, storekeepers) work during the night as soon as an urgent task requires them.
